annotations.title: Join, vote or RSVP in a book club

description: The linked reader's own answer in a book club: join it from a link, leave it, vote in its open poll, or RSVP to its next meeting. Suits "join this club", "vote for Piranesi" and "say I'm coming". The optionId comes from get_club. Members see that the reader joined. Votes show only as totals.
